changelog:
Initial release: Interactive end-to-end Quality Month activity planning assistant.

- Guides users through four key planning stages: proposal, scheduling, publicity, and summary/awards—ensuring mandatory confirmation and transparency for all required aspects.
- Produces both a structured Markdown report and a visually enhanced HTML version, tailored for internal communication and review presentations.
- Clearly marks and calls out any missing or user-unconfirmed information ("供参考·待确认"); never fills in required fields or data on behalf of the user.
- Does not write content on behalf of users for critical fields; strictly provides dimensions, examples, and templates to support organizational decision-making.
- Supports related event types (e.g., safety month) by method; allows cross-skill linkage for activity-specific execution or deeper quality tool support.
- Comprehensive documentation, field boundaries, and procedural discipline ensure reliability and trust.
summary: 交互引导式质量月活动全周期策划助手。覆盖方案策划、活动排期、宣传文案、总结评优四阶段，通过强制交互锁引导用户明确目标、主题、周期、范围、预算与重点活动类型，产出贴合企业实际的《质量月活动总体方案》及配套排期表、宣传文案与总结评优文档。Agent 只引导不替写，所有缺失信息标注「供参考·待确认」。
